annotation_status: Independently authored by a separate Codex agent on 2026-10-22; independent human review pending

issues.issue_definition: Origin of recurring oily residue is unconfirmed
issues.expected_interpretation: Record the unknown origin and investigation before return to service. Do not diagnose a seal failure or link the film to the setting delay without evidence.

issues.issue_definition: Verbal QC clearance and claimed pass precede the signed bearing-face release
issues.expected_interpretation: Capture the historical discrepancy between verbal/telephone passed statements and absent crew release; signed BF-P6-0910 is received on September 10 and closes bearing-face acceptance only. Do not leave bearing-face acceptance open.

issues.issue_definition: Conflicting shim-stack details require a formal technical decision
issues.expected_interpretation: Identify the earlier 6 mm versus 9 mm conflict. Signed TQ-061 and M-214 revision D specify 9 mm on September 11; treat the technical decision as closed.

issues.issue_definition: Internal design draft was not an issued instruction or proof of crew receipt
issues.expected_interpretation: Identify the historical distribution gap independently of the dimensional conflict. Formal issue at 13:10 and crew receipt at 13:35 on September 11 close the gap. No current missing formal-response gap remains.

issues.issue_definition: Pump setting was actually deferred before later physical completion
issues.ground_truth_status: Historical; physical setting completed in DR-D08
issues.expected_interpretation: Report the documented September 9 and 10 shift deferrals and September 12 setting/grouting completion. Do not equate setting completion with commissioning, claim a quantified project delay, or invent an approval-transmission time.

issues.issue_definition: Separate anchor-torque acceptance remains a record-verification gap
issues.expected_interpretation: Distinguish anchor-torque acceptance from closed bearing-face acceptance. AT-P6-0912 appears later, so do not assert that no inspection occurred; the signed sheet is unlinked and unavailable, so acceptance must be verified.
Reconcile 22 received less 19 mixed less 2 returned, leaving 1 bag. Do not infer excess installed grout, theft, a quality failure, or unmeasured installed volume from bag counts.

issues.issue_definition: Preliminary alignment exceeds the stated tolerance and final acceptance remains pending
issues.expected_interpretation: Report 0.18 mm preliminary vertical offset against the 0.10 mm acceptance limit and the required final alignment after cure before start-up. Do not label a final inspection failed, say the pump is operating, or call the scheduled cure overdue.

issues.issue_definition: Instrumentation access was temporarily restricted and notice receipt is uncertain
issues.expected_interpretation: Record the 80-minute restriction and reassignment. A notice was reportedly sent, while chargehand receipt is unestablished. Do not assert that no notice was sent, count a full-shift loss, infer a critical-path effect, or say the adjacent service rack remains closed.
